items.text: Evacuated with Hearthstone's people to Urithiru in 1175, Mil went to Lirin's clinic with months of headaches. Kaladin, who knew him from before, suspected migraines, gave him medicine and asked him to record his symptoms for a month, which made Mil grin from ear to ear.

appearance.text: An older man with a friendly face and the patchy beard he had always wanted to grow out.
